text: Program Description Medical Jurisprudence training with the basic theory of medical knowledge and the system of forensic medicine theory knowledge and basic skills, can in the organs of public security, political science and law, the judicial authentication institutions and insurance companies engaged in the work of forensic identification test case advanced science and technology talents. Students mainly learn basic medicine, clinical medicine, law and forensic science basic theory and basic knowledge, basic skills by medical and forensic training, have the basic capabilities of forensic test case identification. Duration 3 years
